name: Brightspace
description_en:
D2L Brightspace is a learning-management platform used for organizing courses, delivering learning materials and tracking progress. D2L positions it for education, training organizations, associations and workplace learning.

The core LMS sits within a larger product family. AI assistance, advanced authoring, analytics, outcome reporting, commerce and integration products are presented as add-ons rather than a single assumed bundle.
description_zh:
D2L Brightspace 是组织课程、交付教材和跟踪进展的学习管理平台，面向教育、培训机构、协会及职场学习。

核心 LMS 属于更大的产品家族。AI 辅助、高级创作、分析、成果报告、电商和集成产品作为附加产品展示，不能假定全部打包包含。

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_zh: 核心 LMS 与 D2L 附加产品
sections.en: The product page describes course creation and delivery, personalized experiences and learning analytics. It separately lists Lumi for AI assistance, Creator+ for authoring, Performance+ for learning insights, Achievement+ for outcomes, Course Merchant for sales and Link for integrations. Treat these as procurement questions, not universally included features. The page describes interoperability through batch processing, APIs and Link recipes, but a particular SIS connection still needs a defined scope.
sections.zh: 产品页介绍课程创作与交付、个性化体验及学习分析，另列 Lumi AI 辅助、Creator+ 创作、Performance+ 分析、Achievement+ 成果、Course Merchant 销售和 Link 集成。应把这些作为采购问题，而非默认包含的能力。页面介绍批处理、API 和 Link 配方互通，但具体 SIS 连接仍需明确范围。

sections.title_en: Example: move one course before a full migration
sections.title_zh: 示例：完整迁移前先搬一门课
sections.en: Select a course with representative content, assignments and grading requirements. Import or recreate it in a pilot environment, enroll instructor and learner test accounts, then compare submissions and grade outcomes with the source. Include a learner who resumes unfinished work. This checks the actual migration rather than assuming that supported bulk transfer preserves every plugin or historical artifact. No course was migrated here.
sections.zh: 选择包含代表性内容、作业和评分要求的课程，在试点环境导入或重建，登记教师和学员测试账户，再对照来源检查提交和成绩。还应检查恢复未完成学习。这样才能验证实际迁移，不能因为支持批量传输就假定所有插件与历史材料都保留。本文未迁移课程。

sections.title_zh: 按明确范围沟通采购方案
sections.en: The official sales page offers an intake call, tailored demonstration and action plan, with no public amount or fixed billing unit in the retrieved text. Pricing therefore remains contact-based and numerically unknown. Ask for the learner definition, contract period, included add-ons, implementation, SIS integration, migration, support and renewal terms. A demo request is not evidence of a perpetual free plan.
sections.zh: 官方销售页提供需求沟通、定制演示及行动方案，本次文本没有公开金额或固定计费单位，因此仅记录联系销售，金额未知。需询问学员定义、合同周期、附加产品、实施、SIS 集成、迁移、支持和续费条件。演示申请不是持续免费套餐的依据。

sections.title_en: Institutional configuration is part of adoption
sections.title_zh: 机构配置是采用过程的一部分
sections.en: Brightspace is relevant when an organization needs shared course delivery, roles and learning records. Course designers, administrators and integration owners should agree what constitutes completion and how errors will be reconciled. Analytics can reveal patterns but cannot by itself demonstrate learning causality. Self-hosting, source licensing, exact retention and contractual accessibility obligations were not verified; official marketing outcomes were not adopted as measured results.
sections.zh: 组织需要共享课程交付、角色和学习记录时，可以考虑 Brightspace。课程设计者、管理员和集成负责人应明确完成条件及异常核对方式。分析可以揭示模式，不能单独证明学习因果。自托管、源码许可、保留期限和合同无障碍义务未核实，官方营销成果也未当作实测结果。
